exposure: Number of CDs (stratified into five groups)
women with fewer than five CDs
number of previous CDs (1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or more)
women with five or more CDs
cohort: Women who delivered a singleton live birth after 24 weeks of gestation by CD
finding: Maternal and neonatal morbidity increase with the increasing number of CDs, with women undergoing their fifth CD or more experiencing the highest risks.
mod_finding: The risks of neonatal ICU admission and RDS were higher in elective CDs performed at term compared to preterm births in women with multiple CDs.
